name: PAUL
canonical: Paul of Tarsus, formerly Saul the Pharisee (the apostle to the Gentiles, NOT one of the Twelve), a short stocky strong-built man of about forty-five with light-olive skin, a high balding domed forehead with the hair receded to a fringe, a strong heavy prominent brow over piercing penetrating eyes, a long pointed greying dark-brown beard with natural human hair colour (never green or unnatural tints), a learned commanding intensity to his lined scholarly face, dressed in a plain dark-brown traveller's mantle over an undyed tunic, gripping a rolled parchment scroll in one hand
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
